summary: Pass. All five Review B findings F1-F5 are fixed and machine-verified, and both new surfaces (the live export shape and the ra-quota read) fail closed. F1: the production daemon_pids, extracted verbatim from review-run.sh and confirmed identical in judge-run.sh, selects a real NUL-separated argv 'opencode.exe serve --service' process on a synthetic table through BENCH_OPENCODE_PROC. F2: the same guard refuses a HOME string of '<root>/../outside/home', a sibling '<root>-other/home', and a HOME symlink that resolves out of the root. F3: the runners record starttime at TERM and skip the KILL on mismatch; the production functions honor BENCH_OPENCODE_PROC and the comparison expression was exercised on a changed starttime. F4: with TMPDIR inside the repository, the real provider-credential.sh seed recorded the export cwd at /tmp/mg-seed-export.*, outside the git work tree. F5: the real helper refuses a job-home symlink out of the root and a relative job folder, and an unset HOME is safe because the call HOME is explicit. The export selection uses integrationID plus active, refuses ambiguity, and never selects a provider-only entry. quota.ts gives stopped on a stale or missing last-good reading and never ready, and forged ra-quota output fails closed. No new real-HOME call form exists; the credential marker reached neither stdout nor any file. The three gates pass with clean process hygiene.
evidence: F1 withdrawn: daemon_pids from harness/model-guide/review-run.sh (extracted verbatim, byte-identical in judge-run.sh) run against a synthetic /proc tree through BENCH_OPENCODE_PROC selected pid 1001 whose cmdline holds three NUL-separated entries 'opencode.exe serve --service' with HOME and cwd inside the job root. The matched list was exactly [1001].

F2 withdrawn: the same run did not select pid 3001 (HOME string '<root>/../outside/home', cwd outside), pid 3002 (sibling '<root>-other/home'), pid 3003 (argv 'serve --hostname', no --service), or pid 3004 (HOME '<root>/linkhome' a symlink resolving to the outside folder, cwd outside). After pid 3004's cwd was moved outside, the matched list was exactly [1001].

F3 withdrawn: review-run.sh:466-487 records started_at at TERM and skips the KILL when the current starttime differs; judge-run.sh:363-382 holds the same block. daemon_starttime reads field 22 (index 19 after the comm strip) and honors BENCH_OPENCODE_PROC: t1001=111111. The exact production comparison, run after rewriting the stat starttime to 999999, printed 'MISMATCH -> KILL skipped (reused pid safe)'. The plan records that F3 has no automated test and routes a BENCH_OPENCODE_PROC test to the hardening row.

F4 withdrawn: the real provider-credential.sh run in seed mode with TMPDIR=<repo>/measure/runs (a git rev-parse --show-toplevel of the repo root) recorded the export call cwd as /tmp/mg-seed-export.cNict0 in the fake log, and /tmp is not inside a work tree. The run_exit was 0 with 0 bytes of stdout; no FAKE-SECRET-MARKER file exists under the job tree.

F5 withdrawn: the real helper refused 'the call HOME is outside the job root' (exit 2) when $JOB/home was a symlink to a folder outside the root, refused 'the job root must be an absolute path' (exit 2) for a relative BENCH_OPENCODE_HOME, refused 'no job folder' for an unset BENCH_OPENCODE_HOME, and ran scan-values cleanly with ambient HOME unset because run_opencode sets HOME=$FOLDER/home explicitly. provider-credential.sh:119-133 resolves with realpath -m on a path boundary; review-run.sh:695-705 and judge-run.sh hold the same resolved comparison for the job HOME.

Live export shape: scan-values with one active integrationID entry printed exactly the access value and the orgID. Two active entries refused 'ambiguous' (exit 2), and an entry with only a provider field refused 'no entry' with empty stdout (exit 2). SELECT_JS (provider-credential.sh:143-176) selects entry.integrationID === provider && entry.active === true.

Quota through ra-quota, run live with BENCH_RA_QUOTA pointed at node doubles: a usable live entry gave ready with windows {5h:10,weekly:20,monthly:5}; an empty ra-quota with no RA_QUOTA_LASTGOOD gave stopped naming the missing reading; an empty ra-quota with a 7 h-old reading gave stopped naming the stale reading; an empty ra-quota with a 30-minute-old reading gave ready from the last-good fallback; a forged non-JSON output with no last-good gave stopped. A stale or missing reading never gave ready, and forged output failed closed.

No new real-HOME call form: the only opencode binary calls are review-run.sh:732 and judge-run.sh:516 ('run --standalone' with HOME=$JOB/home), provider-credential.sh:194 (the one exempt seed export: fixed form 'auth export <provider> --standalone', timeout 60, real HOME, cwd in an empty non-git folder), and provider-credential.sh:244,252 (import/export through run_opencode with the job HOME). quota.ts spawns only the BENCH_RA_QUOTA command and 'openchamber status --json' with array argv (no shell).

Credential containment: the seed run wrote 0 bytes to stdout, the import carried the payload on stdin with refresh replaced by inert, the stderr files are created under umask 077 and removed by the EXIT trap, and a grep for FAKE-SECRET-MARKER under the job tree found nothing. The fake log confirmed exactly two calls with the expected HOMEs.

Provenance: the audited head 1572612a513316c21dcc22b84e61338e19815ba3 was HEAD when this review started; during the audit the operator committed ee48a25 (docs only: measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md and spec.md), which names no code or test file. phase_base_sha 57baaaa364f968a2f44c6e14eb96f8a9d68beebf and role_base_sha 42bdece8953ce3b25e230fd234e4698c30044d60 are ancestors of the audited range; git status --porcelain shows no tracked change from this review.

Security applicability: applicable. The range c46161f..1572612 changes harness/model-guide/review-run.sh, judge-run.sh, provider-credential.sh, and adds quota.ts, moving a credential through a pipe, guarding HOMEs, killing processes by pid, and reading quota through an external command, so secret handling, process scope, and fail-closed reads decide the security state.

Scope: git diff --stat c46161f..1572612 names 10 files: the three scripts, the new quota.ts, four test files (review-run, judge-run, credential-provider, quota), the fake-opencode fixture, and plan.md. The list matches the declared file set of plan rows 4.13q and 4.13r; no production file outside the planned set changed.
A2 (consent-blind publish gate): not applicable; the range flips no draft-to-published status and publishes no named subject.

A6 (registry overstatement): not triggered. measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md row 4.13r claims match the implementation, and the follow-up docs commit ee48a25 correctly states that quota.ts keeps no default ra-quota path (verified: quota.ts reads ra-quota only when BENCH_RA_QUOTA names it).

ratings.evidence: Every F1-F5 fix was proven against the production scripts on synthetic and live fixtures, and the ra-quota stale, missing, and forged cases all gave stopped or a fresh-reading fallback (review-run.sh daemon_pids run on /tmp/opencode/rb160/proc; provider-credential.sh seed with TMPDIR inside the repo; quota.ts with node doubles).

D1-D4, N3, S6, C8-C11, H1, H2, and Q16a-d are real failing-first tests (65 + 22 + 30 pass at HEAD), but F3's starttime check has no automated pin, which the plan concedes and routes to the hardening row.
